entries.en: V, talk to me.
entries.ro: V, vorbește cu mine.

entries.en: V, talk. Make it quick.
entries.ro: V, vorbește. Fă-o repede.

entries.en: V, what's up? We're talking.
entries.ro: V, ce mai faci? Vorbeam.

entries.en: Hey, we weren't done here.
entries.ro: Hei, nu terminasem aici.

entries.en: So, back to what we were saying?
entries.ro: Deci, revenim la ce spuneam?

entries.en: What were we...?
entries.ro: Ce spuneam...?

entries.en: Well? No time for this.
entries.ro: Ei? Nu avem timp de asta.

entries.en: Hm?
entries.ro: Hm?

entries.en: Watch it.
entries.ro: Atenție.

entries.en: 'Ey!
entries.ro: Hei!

entries.en: I've got someone, needs to be removed.
entries.ro: Am pe cineva de eliminat.

entries.en: There's a reward for a certain someone. Could be yours.
entries.ro: E o recompensă pe capul cuiva. Ar putea fi a ta.

entries.en: I heard someone needs help. Job's for you.
entries.ro: Am auzit că cineva are nevoie de ajutor. Jobul e pentru tine.

entries.en: Need you to save someone in distress.
entries.ro: Trebuie să salvezi pe cineva în pericol.

entries.en: Got a job. Sabotage. Just the thing for you.
entries.ro: Am o treabă. Sabotaj. Exact ce-ți trebuie.

entries.en: Need your help. You'll damage something for me, we'll both get paid.
entries.ro: Am nevoie de tine. O să strici ceva pentru mine și ne plătesc pe amândoi.

entries.en: Got a specific job – need a delivery.
entries.ro: Am o treabă anume – am nevoie de o livrare.

entries.en: Got a package to carry. Quick as can be.
entries.ro: Am un pachet de cărat. Cât mai repede.

entries.en: My client wants to retrieve something. We'll help.
entries.ro: Clientul meu vrea să recupereze ceva. Vom ajuta.

entries.en: There's something I need to get back for a client. I'll need your help.
entries.ro: Trebuie să recuperez ceva pentru un client. Am nevoie de tine.

entries.en: Need a certain thing. You'll steal it for me.
entries.ro: Îmi trebuie un lucru anume. O să-l furi pentru mine.

entries.en: Client will say what they need, then pay. You bring me that thing. Simple.
entries.ro: Clientul zice ce vrea, apoi plătește. Tu îmi aduci chestia aia. Simplu.

entries.en: I can pick it up from the locker, no problem.
entries.ro: Îl pot lua din locker, fără problemă.

entries.en: Leave the package in the locker. I'll take it from there.
entries.ro: Lasă pachetul în locker. Îl iau de acolo.

entries.en: 'Ey, hello? Can you hear me?
entries.ro: Hei, salut? Mă auzi?

entries.en: V! You still there?
entries.ro: V! Mai ești acolo?
